item.title: Women Peace & Security – Malta’s Second National Action Plan (2025-2030)
item.description:
Following the successful implementation of Malta’s first National Action Plan (NAP) on Women, Peace and Security (WPS) for the period 2020–2024, Malta launched its second NAP in December 2025.
